_invariant: These identifiers must NOT resolve through the same source the harness resolves through. A harness that asserts an identifier was not touched cannot obtain it from the resolver under test: one resolver defect would move both the assertion and the thing asserted, and the assertion would pass trivially.
These values must NOT be merged into app/shared/ghl-config.ts. Adding them changes schemaLeafCount, invalidates the frozen binding artifact scripts/ghl-bindings.json, and trips A0.
Merging this file into GhlConfig defeats every assertion that reads it. If that looks like a tidy refactor, read the two paragraphs above again.
